claim: Hybrid candidate generation improves or preserves relevant-knowledge recall relative to either single retrieval route.
evaluation_rule: SUPPORTED iff candidate-pool recall is >= both BM25 Recall@10 and Vector Recall@10; MIXED iff only one route is preserved.

claim: qwen3-rerank improves ranked relevance quality over the preregistered Hybrid-RRF baseline.
evaluation_rule: SUPPORTED iff Hybrid+Reranker is non-inferior to Hybrid-RRF on Recall@5, MRR@10, and nDCG@5 with at least one strict improvement; MIXED for split directions.

claim: Hybrid+Reranker provides the strongest overall retrieval quality among the evaluated methods.
evaluation_rule: SUPPORTED iff Hybrid+Reranker is non-inferior to the best other method on Recall@5, MRR@10, and nDCG@5 with at least one strict improvement; MIXED for split directions.

claim: Improved retrieval metrics directly improve real adolescents' health outcomes.
evaluation_rule: Always UNSUPPORTED because this retrieval benchmark does not measure real adolescent health outcomes.
